item.title: Road enforcement corruption: MACC freezes accounts, seizes RM7.7 million, arrests 18 individuals
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) has frozen and seized property worth RM7.7 million through Op Middleman, which targets individuals believed to be involved in corruption involving road enforcement. MACC Chief Commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki said the amount included cash, luxury vehicles, jewellery and the freezing of dozens of individual and company accounts as a result of three months of intelligence. item.title: Retail price of RON97 up 10 sen, diesel in Peninsular up 8 sen – MOF
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The retail price of RON97 petrol has been increased by 10 sen to RM3.25 per litre for the period from March 5 to 11, following the increase in world oil prices. In a statement today, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) announced that the retail price of diesel in Peninsular Malaysia has increased by eight sen to RM3.12 per litre, while in Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan it remains at RM2.15 per litre.
